overall_summary: Analysis of 38 YouTube Shorts shows that large-scale astronomical and atmospheric high-concept scenarios ('Earth Had Rings Like Saturn', 'Earth Lost Its Atmosphere for 5 Seconds', 'Sound Could Travel Through Space') generate the highest total view counts (701 - 1,038 views). Videos designed with brief, seamless loop mechanics ('Earth Passed Through Saturn's Rings', 'Solar Wind Hit Earth at Light Speed') achieve extreme watch percentages ranging from 94.95% to 361.81%. Low-performing videos suffer from immediate 0-10% progress drop-offs when visual payoffs are delayed or topics lack cosmic stakes.

what_is_working.evidence: 'What If Earth Had Rings Like Saturn?' achieved 1,038 views (50.75% avg percentage watched), and 'What If Earth Lost Its Atmosphere for 5 Seconds?' gained 881 views (64.26% avg percentage watched).
what_is_working.action: Prioritize celestial-scale events and planetary-level structural alterations over micro/localized physical changes.

what_is_working.evidence: 'What If Earth Passed Through Saturn's Rings?' achieved 195.54% average view percentage with audience watch ratios remaining above 2.74 through 49% progress.
what_is_working.action: Design 15-30 second shorts with infinite seamless loops where the conclusion directly feeds back into the opening hook phrase.

what_to_improve.evidence: 'What If You Could See Every Wi-Fi Signal?' (41 views), 'What If Water Turned Into Liquid Mercury?' (22 views), and 'What If All Sand Turned to Glass?' (24 views) struggled to attract broader impressions.
what_to_improve.action: Eliminate niche earth-bound conceptual scenarios; reframe hypotheses around planetary or solar-system impacts.

what_to_improve.pattern: Severe Early Drop-Off on Instant-Action Hooks
what_to_improve.evidence: 'What If Earth's Gravity Reversed For 5 Seconds?' lost retention rapidly, dropping to an audience watch ratio of 0.75 by 10% progress and relative retention of 0.0992.
what_to_improve.action: Show the visual transformation in frame 1 alongside the spoken hook instead of using text titles or delay frames.

retention_insights.evidence: 'What If Earth Passed Through Saturn's Rings?' maintained audience watch ratio from 3.6286 at 1% progress to 2.7429 at 49% progress, driving 195.54% watch time.
retention_insights.action: Maintain high visual motion and repeat key payoff visuals near the last 2 seconds to incentivize re-watching.

retention_insights.evidence: 'What If Earth's Gravity Reversed For 5 Seconds?' saw relative retention collapse from 0.3044 at 1% to 0.1362 at 10% progress.
retention_insights.action: Cut narration preamble and deliver immediate simulation graphics within the first 0.5 seconds.

best_posting_windows.reason: Top performer 'What If Earth Had Rings Like Saturn?' (1,038 views) was published at 04:56 UTC, and 'What If Sound Could Travel Through Space?' (701 views) was published at 04:47 UTC.
Top performer 'What If Earth Lost Its Atmosphere for 5 Seconds?' (881 views) was published at 12:08 UTC, and 'What If an Asteroid Smashed Through the Moon?' (393 views) was published at 12:49 UTC.
